# Gap before section 1

54 KB of 0xFF, never copied; always ready if the boot copy end is raised.

**Category:** free space · **Address:** `0x600d0800` to `0x600de000` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Becomes always ready if the boot-copy end immediate at 0x600211af is raised to 0x600de000. Not tried on a camera.
